title: The Blood Pressure row's "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" wraps to two lines at 375 and 390 when a previous value shows, against US-62 AC8a's one-line claim
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: the cause was the name column's width, not the previous value. In real WebKit (iPhone 13 profile, Pages dev build) "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" is 151.6px wide at 12px; the name column was 147px at 375 (44px trend) and 150px at 390 (56px trend), so the date wrapped with one reading or two, SI and US. The 104px value column is fixed: "126/80 (132/84)" is 106.8px and overflows it rather than widening it. Fix: .md-row-name takes margin-right: -6px, half the 12px gap, so the name block is 153px at 375 and 156px at 390; the trend, value column, row height and tap target do not move. Every dated row's line measured one line after. Was: Found on main (9ac060dca) in PR 1710 (H83), real WebKit, iPhone 13 profile, SI, a man of 51 at 178 cm with two pressures (126/80 after 132/84). The meta line breaks after "Aug", leaving "2026" on its own line; the Range line count is 2 at both 375 and 390, in SI and US units. US-62 AC8a says the trend stays 44 wide below 390px so "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" keeps one line at 375px; the bracketed previous "(132/84)" widens the reading column. Shots: h83-rows-si-375-bp.png and h83-rows-si-390-bp.png (and the us ones), listed in PR 1710's body. (H104)
